forbidden_actions: Do not install, update, activate, create, or manage dependency environments, execution infrastructure, remote job systems, or model-hosting infrastructure.
Do not run on filtered counts when a method requires unfiltered droplets, merge captures, guess expected recovery, or infer filtered-to-raw correspondence.
Do not overwrite raw or filtered source counts, replace identifiers, or silently select one corrected method by desired biological appearance.
Do not report an untested barcode as empty, a corrected count as raw, or generated code and unreloaded outputs as scientific evidence.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Declare lower, optional retain, iterations and FDR from barcode-rank and precision requirements before calls are reviewed.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Retain Limited flags and reported FDR; never recompute FDR from PValue or label untested droplets negative.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Prefer automatic estimation when reviewed clusters and informative markers exist; use a fixed fraction only when externally justified and retain sensitivity.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Record marker warnings and block implausible or unstable rho from automatic adoption.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Derive priors from the unfiltered barcode rank distribution and protocol, then retain declared sensitivity around consequential choices.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Block outputs with incompatible versions, failed checkpoints, non-finite or negative counts, missing probabilities, or unreconciled barcodes.

postflight_checks: Reconcile every raw barcode to emptyDrops test status and every corrected barcode and feature to its source identity.
Inspect ambient profiles, rho distributions, CellBender loss and posterior fields, removed counts, marker shifts, sample effects and method disagreement.
Reload all outputs, verify finite nonnegative counts and stable identifiers, prove source digests unchanged, and retain no-correction sensitivity.
preflight_checks: Inspect actual raw and filtered count bundles, sample identity, chemistry, expected recovery, barcode rank structure, feature types and source digests.
Detect exact DropletUtils, SoupX, CellBender, Python, R, torch and pyro versions in existing compatible runtimes.
Verify nonnegative integer-like counts, exact raw-filtered feature identity, filtered-barcode subset equality, immutable inputs and new output paths.

template_sections.purpose: Establish raw droplet, filtered cell, chemistry, loading, and feature semantics before calling or correction.
required_logic: Inspect immutable raw and filtered matrices, sample identity, chemistry, expected recovery, features, barcodes and source digests.
Reconcile every filtered barcode and count vector to raw droplets before any method runs.
Predeclare methods, emptyDrops FDR and Monte Carlo settings, SoupX estimation mode, CellBender priors, backend and sensitivity plan.

template_sections.purpose: Run emptyDrops, SoupX and CellBender without conflating their estimands or overwriting source data.
required_logic: Run emptyDrops on unfiltered droplets and preserve Total, LogProb, PValue, Limited and FDR for every barcode.
Run SoupX with explicit automatic or fixed contamination estimation and retain rho, ambient profile, clusters, markers, warnings and corrected counts.
Run CellBender on unfiltered input with declared expected cells, included droplets, model, FPR, epochs and backend; retain latent probabilities and output HDF5.

template_sections.purpose: Compare contamination evidence before selecting a corrected representation.
required_logic: Compare barcode calls, ambient profiles, removed-count fractions, gene-level shifts, cell totals, marker preservation, sample distributions and downstream sensitivity.
Flag extreme contamination, low-complexity marker failure, unstable CellBender loss or posterior, and biologically implausible selective depletion.
Select one output only through predeclared technical and biological quality gates; retain all alternatives and the raw-count branch.

template_sections.purpose: Bind method outputs to reloadable artifacts and source-preserving provenance.
required_logic: Reload Matrix Market and CellBender HDF5 outputs and reconcile dimensions, identifiers, finite nonnegative counts and latent variables.
Verify source digests remain unchanged and record exact versions, parameters, warnings and output digests.
Admit only observed outputs that pass all gates; preserve unresolved method disagreement and no-correction sensitivity.

assumptions: The raw matrix contains empty droplets, filtered barcodes are a count-identical subset of raw droplets, each capture is analyzed separately, and correction outputs remain alternatives until project-specific diagnostics select one.

description: Direct Codex to inspect unfiltered and filtered droplet counts, execute emptyDrops, SoupX, and CellBender in compatible existing scientific runtimes, preserve each method's assumptions and outputs, and admit only barcode-reconciled, nonnegative, reload-validated contamination evidence into downstream single-cell analysis.
intents: detect empty droplets and remove ambient RNA
单细胞空滴识别 ambient RNA 去污染 emptyDrops SoupX CellBender
limitations: Validated execution covers raw-versus-filtered barcode reconciliation, emptyDrops 1.22.0, SoupX 1.6.2 fixed and automatic contamination modes, and CellBender 0.3.2 on a CPU-compatible torch 1.13.1 plus pyro 1.8.6 runtime. The public PBMC3k case validates emptyDrops and automatic SoupX on one healthy-donor 10x capture while preserving the observed disagreement with Cell Ranger; CellBender retains executable fixture evidence rather than public biological acceptance evidence. Corrected outputs remain method-specific alternatives requiring project diagnostics; the plugin invokes but does not install or manage compute environments.
preconditions: Codex can inspect raw and filtered count bundles, chemistry and expected recovery; requested methods exist in compatible scientific runtimes; source artifacts are immutable; and new output paths are available.

concept_sources: Project-owned droplet and ambient-RNA workflow synthesized around immutable source counts and method-separated evidence.

quality_gates.description: Raw and filtered matrices must have identical ordered features; every filtered barcode and count vector must reconcile exactly to the raw droplet matrix.
Every raw barcode must retain total counts, Monte Carlo test status, p-value, limited flag, FDR, and a declared call threshold without treating untested barcodes as negatives.
Ambient profiles, SoupX contamination fractions, CellBender priors and probabilities, warnings, and sensitivity settings must be inspected; implausible estimates block automatic adoption.
Corrected counts must be finite, nonnegative, integer-like where promised, identifier-stable, reloadable, and never exceed source counts under subtraction-based correction.
emptyDrops, SoupX, and CellBender outputs must remain method-labeled alternatives; one method cannot be reported as another or selected by desired biological appearance.
Raw and filtered source artifacts must retain their original digests and must never be overwritten by corrected matrices.

questions: Which barcodes deviate from the ambient pool, how much ambient RNA is supported by each method, and which corrected count representation is scientifically admissible without destroying the immutable source counts?
title: Call non-empty droplets and quantify ambient RNA with emptyDrops, SoupX, and CellBender

version_differences.description: Monte Carlo p-values, automatic retention, lower threshold, and FDR semantics are version-coupled.
version_differences.required_action: Record lower, retain, iterations, seed, limited flags, p-values and FDR without recomputing FDR from raw p-values.

version_differences.description: Soup profile estimation, cluster marker selection, contamination estimation, and count adjustment are parameter-sensitive.
version_differences.required_action: Record clusters, marker-selection settings, fixed or automatic contamination mode, rho distribution, removed counts, and warnings.

version_differences.description: CellBender 0.3.1 had an output integer-overflow defect; 0.3.2 is required for validated corrected matrices.
version_differences.required_action: Reject 0.3.1 outputs unless regenerated from a valid checkpoint with a corrected release; verify nonnegative counts after reload.
